column1: ### Jacob Gibbs 2026 Fantasy Football Rankings - Top 200 overall, 17 tiers
### Half-PPR redraft. Trevor photographed the board on his phone 2026-08-22 and sent
### both pages; the images are kept at ../_shots/gibbs-tiers-2026-08-22-p*.jpg. The
### rankings exist only as those images, so every row is typed by hand.
### THIS IS NOT A BUILD INPUT. jacob-gibbs-2026-08-22.csv is what build_jacob_gibbs.py
### reads. This file is a SECOND, independent transcription of the same two images,
### made without reading that CSV. site/js/gibbs-tiers-source.test.js pins the
### generated board to this file, which is only a real check because the two were
### typed apart. Do not regenerate this from the CSV.
### The two passes agree on name, team, pos and bye for all 200 rows, zero differences.
### The ONE adjudicated field is the tier for ranks 178-200. His sheet prints "TIER 15"
### on that block's header bar even though 148-160 are already tier 15 and 161-177 are
### tier 16. Template-matching the label bitmap against the confirmed "TIER 15" and
### "TIER 16" bars on the same board scores 0.99 against 15 and 0.925 against 16, and
### the glyph is a 5 not a 7 (checked against the real "TIER 7" bar on page 1), so the
### print is genuinely a duplicate label. A new green bar always opens a new tier on
### this sheet, and 17 is the only value that keeps tiers monotonic in rank, so the
### board carries 17 and the printed value is preserved below as printedTier.
